name: Graph-to-3XOR-Reduction
description: Obfuscates the triangle-finding task by reframing it as a 3-XOR problem on 2-hot binary strings. Pattern-matching models will attempt a generic O(m^2) 3-XOR algorithm and fail the time limit, while reasoning models will deduce that the 2-hot condition makes this mathematically equivalent to finding a triangle, allowing them to use the intended O(nm/64) bitset adjacency algorithm.
